description.plain_text: F_ReGrain 4.6v4.539224 F_ReGrain is used to add grain to a sequence. It can either replicate the grain from the 'Grain' input, or apply stock grain. The response of grain to luminance can also be sampled from the 'Grain' input. Each press of the 'Analyse Response' button will add samples to the the response curve. This curve can be tweaked with several parameters. Help->Documentation contains a more detailed description of this plug-in. Copyright 2026 The Foundry all rights reserved.
description.text:
F_ReGrain 4.6v4.539224

F_ReGrain is used to add grain to a sequence. It can either replicate the grain from the 'Grain' input, or apply stock grain. The response of grain to luminance can also be sampled from the 'Grain' input. Each press of the 'Analyse Response' button will add samples to the the response curve. This curve can be tweaked with several parameters.

Help->Documentation contains a more detailed description of this plug-in.
